dossier.purpose: Client-side monorepo for E2B (FoundryLabs, Inc.): JavaScript/TypeScript SDK `e2b`, Python SDK `e2b` (sync and async), CLI `@e2b/cli`, thin wrappers `@e2b/code-interpreter`/`e2b-code-interpreter` and `@e2b/desktop`/`e2b-desktop`, and the OpenAPI/protobuf specs the clients are generated from. The SDKs create and drive Linux sandboxes that run remotely on E2B Cloud, or on a self-hosted/BYOC deployment of the separate e2b-dev/runtime project. `Sandbox.create()` POSTs /v2/sandboxes at https://api.<domain> with an API key (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:1747-1750). Commands, files and PTYs then run inside the sandbox through its `envd` daemon over Connect-RPC (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/index.ts:167-226). Per-task separation is done with separate sandboxes, `fork` (up to 20 copies of a checkpointed sandbox: sandboxApi.ts:535-554, index.ts:425-445), snapshots, and pause/resume. Enforced restrictions are API options on the remote sandbox: egress allow/deny lists (CIDR, IP, hostname), an internet on/off switch, per-host header transforms, an optional SOCKS5 egress proxy, public-URL traffic tokens, and always-on secured envd access. The repo contains no local OS-level filesystem or network rule engine and no WSL2/macOS-specific sandboxing code. Whole-repo greps for seccomp, landlock, bubblewrap, seatbelt, sandbox-exec, firejail, nsjail, gVisor, firecracker, microVM and WSL found nothing. The sandbox runtime that actually isolates workloads is not in this repo; only its API specs are synced here (spec/README.md:8-12).

claims.claim: E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
To start and control sandboxes, use the JavaScript SDK (npm `e2b`) or Python SDK (PyPI `e2b`).
Usage requires signing up to E2B, getting an API key, and setting the E2B_API_KEY environment variable (e2b_***).
`Sandbox.create()` followed by `sandbox.commands.run('echo "Hello from E2B!"')` returns the command's stdout (JS, and Python as a context manager).
`runCode()`/`run_code()` needs the separate Code Interpreter SDK (`@e2b/code-interpreter` / `e2b-code-interpreter`).
The Desktop SDK (`@e2b/desktop` / `e2b-desktop`) provides mouse, keyboard, screenshot, application and desktop-streaming APIs for computer use.
Self-hosting: follow the embed deployment guide to set up the E2B runtime (github.com/e2b-dev/runtime) on your own; the infrastructure is deployed using Terraform.
Supported self-host targets: AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), Azure, and a general Linux machine (via Embed).
CLI install: `brew install e2b` on macOS, or `npm install -g @e2b/cli`.
CLI auth: `e2b auth login`, or provide E2B_API_KEY as an environment variable where a browser cannot be opened (CI/CD).
Each Desktop sandbox is isolated from the others and can be customized with any dependencies.

Python SDK shares one set of HTTP/2 connections across all sandboxes in a process; a new connection is dialed only when every existing one carries E2B_STREAMS_PER_CONNECTION streams (default 100), up to E2B_MAX_CONNECTIONS (default 200); both are read at import.

install.command: npm i @e2b/code-interpreter  # JavaScript/TypeScript ; pip install e2b-code-interpreter  # Python
npm i @e2b/desktop  # JavaScript/TypeScript ; pip install e2b-desktop  # Python

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes: CI runs the JS, Python and CLI suites on ubuntu-22.04 (.github/workflows/js_sdk_tests.yml:48, python_sdk_tests.yml:30, cli_tests.yml:29). The SDKs are pure TypeScript/Python with no native code built in this repo (Python deps include native wheels such as pyqwest, packages/python-sdk/pyproject.toml:23). CPU architecture is not stated in the workflows.
platforms.wsl2: unknown: no mention of WSL/WSL2 anywhere in the repo (whole-repo grep, lockfiles excluded). A WSL2 shell would take the generic Linux code path: the CLI's browser opener uses xdg-open on non-darwin/non-win32 (packages/cli/src/utils/openBrowser.ts:11-19) and prints a manual login URL if the opener fails (packages/cli/src/commands/auth/login.ts:156-167). Native Windows is CI-tested (windows-latest) but that is not WSL2.
platforms.macos_arm64: yes: Homebrew install documented for macOS (packages/cli/README.md:15-19) and the CLI has a darwin branch (packages/cli/src/utils/openBrowser.ts:11-13). It is not exercised in CI (only ubuntu-22.04 and windows-latest runners) and arm64 is not mentioned.
platforms.gpu: no: nothing in the repo mentions or requires a GPU (grep for GPU/CUDA/nvidia outside lockfiles: 0 hits). SandboxOpts has no GPU option (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:588-683).

integrations.cli: yes: `e2b` binary from npm `@e2b/cli` (packages/cli/package.json:71-73) with command groups auth, template, sandbox (packages/cli/src/commands/index.ts:23-25). Sandbox subcommands are connect, info, list, kill, pause, resume, create, logs, metrics, exec, snapshot, fork (packages/cli/src/commands/sandbox/index.ts:20-32). `sandbox create` exposes only lifecycle, timeout, user, cwd and env flags, with no network/egress flags (packages/cli/src/commands/sandbox/create.ts:32-51).
integrations.mcp: No standalone MCP server for MCP clients found in this repo. The SDK has an `mcp` option on Sandbox.create that starts an in-sandbox `mcp-gateway` (as root) and exposes getMcpUrl()/getMcpToken() (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/index.ts:325-344, 721-738; Python packages/python-sdk/e2b/sandbox_sync/main.py:236-257). spec/mcp-server.json is the catalog schema of MCP servers for that option and is owned by this repo (spec/README.md:34-35).
integrations.sdk_or_api: SDKs: JS/TS `e2b` (packages/js-sdk), Python `e2b` with sync Sandbox and async AsyncSandbox (packages/python-sdk/e2b/__init__.py:113,125), an `E2B` bound-client class (packages/js-sdk/README.md:48-67), plus @e2b/code-interpreter, e2b-code-interpreter, @e2b/desktop and e2b-desktop. HTTP API: REST OpenAPI spec for https://api.e2b.app authenticated by the X-API-Key header (spec/openapi.yml:1-14). In-sandbox envd HTTP and Connect-RPC (process, filesystem) specs are in spec/envd/envd.yaml, spec/envd/process/process.proto and spec/envd/filesystem/filesystem.proto.
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: none found as an integration: no Claude Code or Codex plugin, skill, hook, .mcp.json, .claude/ directory or AGENTS.md (globs found none). Only mentions: CLAUDE.md holds contributor instructions for coding agents working on this repo (pnpm/uv, changesets, Linear MCP for PRs) (CLAUDE.md:1-10). The CLI `sandbox exec` help text and tests use `codex exec` as an example remote pass-through command run inside a sandbox (packages/cli/src/commands/sandbox/exec.ts:23-28; packages/cli/tests/commands/sandbox/exec_passthrough.test.ts:107-113).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No analytics or crash-reporting SDK found (greps for telemetry/analytics/sentry/posthog/segment/mixpanel/amplitude in source hit only the CLI's simple-update-notifier dependency). (1) Account: an E2B account and API key are required; both SDKs throw without one (packages/js-sdk/src/api/index.ts:99-105; packages/python-sdk/e2b/api/__init__.py:334-339). Plan tiers cap sandbox lifetime at 1 h (Hobby) / 24 h (Pro) (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:613-617). (2) Network: control-plane calls go to https://api.<domain>, default domain e2b.app, overridable via E2B_DOMAIN, E2B_API_URL, E2B_SANDBOX_URL (packages/js-sdk/src/connectionConfig.ts:500-505, 545-555; packages/python-sdk/e2b/connection_config.py:214-232, 314-323; spec/openapi.yml:6-7). Sandbox traffic goes to https://sandbox.<domain> for e2b.app/e2b.dev/e2b.pro/e2b-staging.dev, else https://<port>-<sandboxId>.<domain> (connectionConfig.ts:8, 569-613). (3) Client metadata is sent on every API request with no opt-out found: headers browser, lang, lang_version, package_version, publisher, sdk_runtime, system (packages/js-sdk/src/api/metadata.ts:8-16 and api/index.ts:116-120; packages/python-sdk/e2b/api/metadata.py:7-14 and api/__init__.py:348-351), and a User-Agent e2b-js-sdk|e2b-python-sdk/<version> plus an integration tag such as e2b-cli/<version> and optional source/<E2B_USER_AGENT_SOURCE> (connectionConfig.ts:393-414; packages/cli/src/api.ts:10). (4) CLI: update check via simple-update-notifier every 8 h, disabled by NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER (packages/cli/src/index.ts:11-22). `e2b auth login` opens a browser at ${E2B_DOCS_BASE or https://e2b.dev/docs}/api/cli with a loopback callback server on 127.0.0.1 (packages/cli/src/commands/auth/login.ts:107-112; packages/cli/src/user.ts:45-47). The API key and OAuth tokens are stored as plaintext JSON in ~/.e2b/config.json (dir 0700, file 0600, 'TODO: Keep in Keychain') (user.ts:37, 148-154). Token refresh POSTs to the OAuth token endpoint (packages/cli/src/utils/token-refresh.ts:42-55). E2B_API_KEY is the non-interactive alternative (packages/cli/README.md:33-37). (5) Debug mode E2B_DEBUG=true targets http://localhost:3000 and localhost:<port> and needs a locally running API/envd built from the separate runtime repo (connectionConfig.ts:75-80, 500-503, 577-579). (6) An optional SOCKS5 egressProxy must be reachable from E2B's infrastructure (sandboxApi.ts:175-201). (7) Secret values are write-only on the server and resolved by the platform via ${e2b.secrets.<name>} placeholders; workload-identity tokens are minted by the egress proxy (packages/js-sdk/src/secret.ts:15-27; packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/iam.ts:70-79). (8) Development only: `make codegen` and scripts/fetch-spec.sh pull specs from GitHub (e2b-dev/runtime, private e2b-dev/belt) through Docker and Copybara (scripts/fetch-spec.sh:43-59).

code.architecture: Client-only monorepo: pnpm workspace `packages/*` (pnpm-workspace.yaml:1-2) plus uv-managed Python packages. JS SDK packages/js-sdk/src: `api/` (openapi-fetch REST client with generated schema.gen.ts, HTTP/2 transport http2.ts), retry.ts, `envd/` (Connect-RPC clients generated from spec/envd/{process,filesystem}/*.proto for the in-sandbox daemon, plus its HTTP API), `sandbox/` (index.ts Sandbox class; sandboxApi.ts create/list/pause/fork/snapshot and the network/egress/lifecycle option types; commands/, commands/pty.ts, filesystem/, deprecated git/, network.ts, iam.ts, signature.ts), `template/` (template builder DSL, Dockerfile parsing, build API), `volume/`, secret.ts, connectionConfig.ts, client.ts. Python SDK packages/python-sdk/e2b mirrors this with separate sync/async trees (sandbox_sync/, sandbox_async/, template_sync/, template_async/, volume/, secret/), a shared sandbox/ package, generated clients (api/client/, volume/client/, envd/*_pb.py, sandbox/mcp.py), and an HTTP/2 connection balancer (api/__init__.py:116-186). CLI packages/cli/src is a commander program (commands/{auth,sandbox,template}) built on the JS SDK. The code-interpreter-* and desktop-* packages subclass the base Sandbox and default to hosted templates `code-interpreter-v1` and `desktop`. spec/ holds OpenAPI/proto files synced by Copybara from e2b-dev/runtime (spec/runtime-ref) and the private e2b-dev/belt (spec/belt-ref) (copy.bara.sky:14-79); `make codegen` regenerates the clients in Docker (Makefile:15-30). templates/ has two Dockerfiles used by tests (base, httpbin). The control plane, orchestrator, sandbox proxy and the in-sandbox envd daemon are NOT in this repo; only their API specs are.
code.packaging_and_release: Artifacts: npm packages `e2b` (packages/js-sdk), `@e2b/cli`, `@e2b/code-interpreter`, `@e2b/desktop`, and PyPI packages `e2b`, `e2b-code-interpreter`, `e2b-desktop` (build backend uv_build: packages/python-sdk/pyproject.toml:56-58). There are no standalone binaries or SDK/CLI container images; the only image push is the `base` sandbox template to DockerHub (.github/workflows/templates.yml:20-48). Flow: Changesets (.changeset/config.json) -> manual `Release` workflow, main branch only (release.yml:3-4, 27-36) -> per-package test jobs -> publish_packages.yml (environment `deployment`, line 22), which runs `pnpm run version`, commits '[skip ci] Release new versions' (lines 85-101), publishes via changesets/action with createGithubReleases: true (lines 103-110) and pushes the commit and tags (112-125). JS publishes with `pnpm changeset publish` (package.json:6). Python publishes with `uv publish --trusted-publishing always --check-url https://pypi.org/simple/` (packages/python-sdk/package.json:9, same in code-interpreter-python and desktop-python), tagged by .github/scripts/publish_python_sdk.sh:5-11 when only python-sdk changes (.github/scripts/publish_command.cjs:8-12). Workflows request `id-token: write` (release.yml:8-10, publish_packages.yml:11-13). No npm token secret is referenced and npm@^11.6 is installed (publish_packages.yml:65-68), consistent with OIDC trusted publishing. No explicit `--provenance`, attestation, checksum, signature or SBOM step exists in the repo (greps found only a Copybara jar SHA256 in copybara.Dockerfile:20-23 and PyPI trusted publishing). PR builds upload .tgz/.whl artifacts with prerelease/local-version tags (pkg_artifacts.yml:76-166). Hygiene: third-party Actions are pinned by commit SHA; pnpm `minimumReleaseAge: 4320` (3 days) delays new dependency versions (pnpm-workspace.yaml:51-53); CI installs with --frozen-lockfile / `uv sync --locked`. The Homebrew formula named in the CLI README is not in this repo.
code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: Vitest 4 for TypeScript (js-sdk projects unit/template/connectionConfig: packages/js-sdk/vitest.config.mts:8-66; extra configs for Bun, Deno, Cloudflare workerd and a Chromium browser) with msw HTTP mocks; pytest with xdist/asyncio/timeout for Python (packages/python-sdk/pyproject.toml:31-41). Lint/type tools: oxlint, prettier, tsc, ruff, ty, knip. Test files, approx.: packages/js-sdk/tests 113 *.test.ts; packages/python-sdk/tests 174 test_*.py; packages/cli/tests 19; packages/code-interpreter-js/tests 34; packages/code-interpreter-python/tests 59; packages/desktop-js/tests 5; packages/desktop-python/tests 3; about 407 in total. The suites mix mocked and live tests: many create real sandboxes and need E2B_API_KEY (packages/js-sdk/tests/setup.ts:70-107; packages/python-sdk/tests/conftest.py:71-88). Egress rules are verified only by live tests that curl from inside a sandbox (packages/js-sdk/tests/sandbox/network.test.ts, internetAccess.test.ts), while request-shape tests use msw (tests/sandbox/egressProxy.test.ts:1-45). CI has 16 workflow files in .github/workflows. sdk_tests.yml (PR to main plus manual, path-filtered, against production and staging domains, with an aggregate status job) fans out to: js_sdk_tests.yml (node on ubuntu-22.04 and windows-latest; bun, deno, cloudflare, cloudflare-deploy and browser on ubuntu-22.04); python_sdk_tests.yml and cli_tests.yml (ubuntu-22.04 and windows-latest); code_interpreter_js/python_tests.yml; desktop_js/python_tests.yml. Other workflows: lint.yml (oxlint, prettier, ruff, fails on uncommitted changes), typecheck.yml, generated_files.yml (re-runs Docker codegen and diffs), pkg_artifacts.yml, release.yml, publish_packages.yml, templates.yml (manual template builds), codegen_image_cache.yml. No macOS runners.

Lockfiles: pnpm-lock.yaml, packages/python-sdk/uv.lock, packages/code-interpreter-python/uv.lock, packages/desktop-python/uv.lock. Engines: Node >=20.18.1 <21 || >=22 (CLI >=22.9.0), Python >=3.10 (.tool-versions pins node 22.18.0, pnpm 10.34.5, python 3.10, uv 0.10.0, bun 1.3.14, deno 2.8.1).
code.security_policy: none: no SECURITY.md or other security policy/disclosure file anywhere in the repo (case-insensitive glob **/*security* found no files; grep for vulnerability/responsible disclosure/security@ found nothing). .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml:1-8 links only to docs and Discord.

claim_checks.claim: README.md:20: E2B is open-source infrastructure that runs AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
claim_checks.evidence: Only the client side is here. The repo has SDKs, CLI and specs, while openapi.yml and the envd specs are synced from e2b-dev/runtime (spec/README.md:8-12; copy.bara.sky:14-61). There is no isolation, VM or OS-sandbox code or terminology anywhere (zero hits for seccomp, landlock, bubblewrap, seatbelt, WSL, gVisor, nsjail, firecracker, microVM). The backend lives in the separate runtime repo (README.md:104-106), so the isolation itself cannot be checked here.

claim_checks.claim: README.md:20: use the JavaScript SDK or Python SDK to start and control sandboxes.
claim_checks.evidence: JS Sandbox.create POSTs /v2/sandboxes (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:1747-1750), then commands/files/pty use Connect-RPC to the sandbox's envd (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/index.ts:167-226). Python: packages/python-sdk/e2b/sandbox_sync/main.py:167-257 and the async twin sandbox_async/main.py.

claim_checks.claim: README.md:36-42: an E2B account and API key (E2B_API_KEY) are required.
claim_checks.evidence: The JS ApiClient throws AuthenticationError without a key and sends it as X-API-KEY (packages/js-sdk/src/api/index.ts:99-105, 116-120). Python raises AuthenticationException (packages/python-sdk/e2b/api/__init__.py:334-342). OpenAPI declares ApiKeyAuth in header X-API-Key (spec/openapi.yml:11-14).

claim_checks.claim: README.md:44-62: sandbox.commands.run('echo ...') runs the command in the sandbox and returns stdout.
claim_checks.evidence: `Commands` is a Connect-RPC client of the in-sandbox process.Process service (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/commands/index.ts:138-150; spec/envd/process/process.proto:5-21); results expose stdout and exitCode (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/commands/commandHandle.ts:25-33). The command executes remotely, not on the caller's host. The Python context manager kills the sandbox on exit (packages/python-sdk/e2b/sandbox_sync/main.py:506-510).

claim_checks.claim: Need-derived reading of README.md:20 ('secure isolated sandboxes'): network egress is deny-by-default. The README never states this.
claim_checks.evidence: Documented default is allow-all: 'If allowOut is not specified, all outbound traffic is allowed' (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:215-219; packages/python-sdk/e2b/sandbox/sandbox_api.py:315-318). The default-create live test expects working internet (packages/js-sdk/tests/sandbox/internetAccess.test.ts:52-63), and the SDK stopped presetting allow_internet_access in 2.51.0 (packages/js-sdk/CHANGELOG.md:34). Restriction is opt-in per sandbox: allowInternetAccess: false or network.denyOut: [ALL_TRAFFIC] (sandboxApi.ts:382-386, 624-627; packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/network.ts:1-4), with allowOut entries winning over denyOut (spec/openapi.yml:474; tests/sandbox/network.test.ts:100-128). Enforcement is server-side and is verified only by live tests.

claim_checks.claim: Need-derived reading of README.md:20: OS-level filesystem read/write rules can be applied to agent commands. The README never states this.
claim_checks.evidence: No such option exists. SandboxOpts has no path or permission rules (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:588-683). Volume mounts carry only name and path (spec/openapi.yml:742-753). Filesystem calls take only a `user` (spec/envd/envd.yaml:357-364). The only boundary offered is the remote sandbox plus user accounts (default `user`, packages/js-sdk/src/connectionConfig.ts:657; commands may run as root, packages/cli/src/commands/sandbox/exec.ts:34).

claim_checks.claim: README.md:104-112: self-hosting the E2B runtime via the embed guide and Terraform on AWS/GCP/Azure/Linux.
claim_checks.evidence: Deployment code is in e2b-dev/runtime, which is not in this repo (spec/README.md:8-12). SDK code documents feature gaps on open-source deployments: egressProxy is 'rejected as unsupported' on a deployment built from the open-source runtime (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:287-289). `onResume` needs a runtime built at or after 2026-08-20 (packages/python-sdk/e2b/sandbox_sync/main.py:280-283). The volume-content API spec comes from the private belt repo (spec/README.md:11-12).

claim_checks.claim: packages/cli/README.md:15-25: install the CLI with `brew install e2b` (macOS) or `npm install -g @e2b/cli`.
claim_checks.evidence: npm: package @e2b/cli with bin `e2b` (packages/cli/package.json:2, 71-73). Homebrew: no formula is in this repo; the only trace is a comment that distro packagers set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER (packages/cli/src/index.ts:11-12), so it is not checkable here.

claim_checks.claim: packages/cli/README.md:33-37: the CLI authenticates in CI/CD via the E2B_API_KEY environment variable.
claim_checks.evidence: ensureAPIKey reads E2B_API_KEY first, falls back to projectApiKey in ~/.e2b/config.json, else prints an error box and exits 1 (packages/cli/src/api.ts:15, 37-50). Login prints a manual URL and the E2B_API_KEY hint when no browser opens (packages/cli/src/commands/auth/login.ts:156-167).

claim_checks.claim: packages/desktop-js/README.md:5: each sandbox is isolated from the others.
claim_checks.evidence: Inter-sandbox isolation is a backend property not implemented in this repo. SDK-side facts: each sandbox has its own ID and envd access token sent per request (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/index.ts:160-163, 187-189). Create v2 always secures system communication (spec/openapi.yml:967-970; packages/js-sdk/CHANGELOG.md:36). Public sandbox URLs default to open (allowPublicTraffic default true, spec/openapi.yml:468-471) and require a traffic token only when set to false (packages/js-sdk/tests/sandbox/network.test.ts:130-168).

benchmarks.what: Python SDK envd HTTP/2 connection-pool sharding: streams opened before a 750 ms deadline against a local peer advertising 100 concurrent streams per connection (three-run median; sync and async gave the same capacity). It measures client connection handling, not isolation or security. The measured fixed-pool mechanism (E2B_ENVD_POOL_SHARDS, four pools by default) was replaced in 2.52.0 by an on-demand balancer (packages/python-sdk/CHANGELOG.md:26, 90-102), and the SVG is not referenced from any README.
benchmarks.metric: streams opened out of 400 requested concurrent long-lived streams
benchmarks.value: 1 pool: 100/400; 4 pools (default at the time): 398/400; 8 pools: 400/400 (chart labels 96 ms near the 8-pool, 400-stream point)

risks: Scope: this repo holds clients and specs only. Sandbox isolation and network enforcement live in the separate e2b-dev/runtime project and E2B Cloud (spec/README.md:8-12; README.md:104-106). Nothing here enforces filesystem or network rules on the caller's own OS, and the repo has no WSL2/macOS-local boundary (zero hits for seccomp, landlock, bubblewrap, seatbelt, sandbox-exec, WSL anywhere).

Hard dependency on an account and network: every sandbox operation needs an E2B API key and reachability of https://api.<domain> and the sandbox host (packages/js-sdk/src/api/index.ts:99-105; packages/js-sdk/src/connectionConfig.ts:500-505, 569-613). Sandbox lifetime is capped at 1 h (Hobby) / 24 h (Pro) (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:613-617). The only local mode, E2B_DEBUG, needs an API/envd built from the runtime repo (connectionConfig.ts:75-80).

Network restrictions are opt-in and server-owned. Egress is allow-all unless set (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:215-219; tests/sandbox/internetAccess.test.ts:52-63). Since 2.51.0 the SDK presets no defaults, so defaults can change server-side without an SDK release (packages/js-sdk/CHANGELOG.md:34-36). denyOut accepts only CIDR/IP, not domains, and allowOut always wins over denyOut (spec/openapi.yml:474-479). updateNetwork replaces the whole egress config and clears omitted fields, including the egress proxy (sandboxApi.ts:354-380; sandbox/index.ts:600-618). UDP traffic (DNS, QUIC) is not tunneled through the egress proxy (sandboxApi.ts:153-157). `e2b sandbox create` has no network flags (packages/cli/src/commands/sandbox/create.ts:32-51).

No filesystem read/write rule feature: sandbox options expose env vars, metadata, timeout, network, iam, lifecycle and volume mounts (name and path only, no read-only flag) (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:588-683; spec/openapi.yml:742-753). Commands and files take a `user` and can run as root (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/commands/index.ts:66; packages/cli/src/commands/sandbox/exec.ts:34).

Self-host / open-source parity gaps documented in SDK code: egressProxy is unsupported on deployments built from the open-source runtime (packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/sandboxApi.ts:287-289); `onResume` needs a runtime built after 2026-08-20 (packages/python-sdk/e2b/sandbox_sync/main.py:280-283); the volume-content API spec is synced from a private repository (spec/README.md:11-12; copy.bara.sky:63-79).

Licensing inconsistency: the root LICENSE is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE:1-4, 189-201), but all seven packages declare and ship MIT (packages/js-sdk/package.json:6; packages/js-sdk/LICENSE:1-3; packages/python-sdk/pyproject.toml:6; likewise cli, code-interpreter-*, desktop-*).

Security/supply chain: no security policy or disclosure file; no signature, checksum, SBOM or explicit provenance flag in the release workflows (.github/workflows/publish_packages.yml). The CLI stores the API key and OAuth tokens as plaintext JSON in ~/.e2b/config.json with a 'TODO: Keep in Keychain' (packages/cli/src/user.ts:37, 148-154). The SDK sends client-metadata headers on every request with no opt-out (packages/js-sdk/src/api/metadata.ts:8-16). The CLI update check is on by default (packages/cli/src/index.ts:11-22).

CI/maintenance: behavior is tested mainly through live runs against E2B production and staging with repo secrets (.github/workflows/sdk_tests.yml:87-221), so it is not reproducible offline. CI covers only ubuntu-22.04 and windows-latest (no macOS or WSL2). The default code owner is a single GitHub user (CODEOWNERS:3). Minor releases carry visible removals and endpoint moves (2.50.0 removed the V1 template APIs; 2.51.0 moved create/connect to v2 endpoints) (packages/js-sdk/CHANGELOG.md:30-50).

checks.statement: Network egress is not deny-by-default: the documented default is allow-all; restriction is opt-in per sandbox via allowInternetAccess: false or denyOut: [ALL_TRAFFIC]; allowOut entries win over denyOut.
checks.note: Every cited line matches. sandboxApi.ts:218 and sandbox_api.py:318 both say that if allowOut/allow_out is not specified, all outbound traffic is allowed. internetAccess.test.ts:52-63 creates a sandbox with no options and expects curl to an external host to return 204. CHANGELOG.md:34 (2.51.0) says create no longer presets allow_internet_access. sandboxApi.ts:382-386 and 624-627 make allowInternetAccess:false equivalent to denyOut 0.0.0.0/0, and network.ts:4 defines ALL_TRAFFIC = '0.0.0.0/0'. openapi.yml:474 says allowed entries always take precedence over denied ones, and network.test.ts:100-128 tests that live. The spec sets no false default for allow_internet_access (openapi.yml:544, 828-831, 947, 1000).
